meta.name: remove-ai-slops
meta.description: Removes AI-generated code smells from branch changes or an explicit file list behind regression tests. Use when the user asks to clean up, deslop, or remove AI-slop patterns from recent changes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 清理代码中AI生成的坏味道与冗余痕迹
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常担心AI助手留下的代码不够干净
copy.tagline_en: Clean up AI-generated code smells and redundant patterns in your recent changes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often worry about messy code left by AI assistants

howto.what: 它先检查这次要动的代码，把行为用回归测试锁住，然后清理分支或指定文件里AI生成风格的垃圾：多余注释、无用死代码、过度防御等，最后跑测试和检查确认行为不变。
howto.when: 当你说要“清理”“去AI味儿”“deslop”等，或要求移除最近改动中的AI痕迹时触发。

say.text: 把这次分支改动里的AI痕迹清理掉。
say.note: 它会先跑回归测试再开删，避免弄坏功能。

say.text: 针对 src/foo.py，去掉多余的注释和死代码。
say.note: 技能会只处理这个文件并做行为锁定。

say.text: 看看哪些地方过度防御，能删就删，测试要保持绿。
say.note: 只有证明冗余才会删，没把握会保留。

howto.what_en: Analyzes the code changed in a branch or passed file list, pins its behavior with regression tests first, then removes AI-style slop such as redundant comments, dead code, and over-defensive code, and verifies tests and checks still pass.
howto.when_en: When the user asks to clean up, deslop, or remove AI-slop patterns from recent changes.

say_en.text: Clean up the AI-slop in this branch's changes.
say_en.note: It locks behavior with tests before deleting anything.

say_en.text: For src/foo.py, remove redundant comments and dead code.
say_en.note: It will limit its pass to that file.

say_en.text: Find over-defensive spots and remove them if provably safe; keep tests green.
say_en.note: Guards at trust boundaries are kept unless proven redundant.
